AGRICULTURAL AI

CropDoctor

Crop-health analysis, voice workflows and irrigation reasoning.

  • Crop health
  • Voice access
  • Water balance
FOCUSED SOURCE CHECKSynthetic soil-water scenarios pass.＋

The supplied Python water-balance function was checked with dry, rainy and saturation inputs. Dry soil loses water, rainfall adds storage and saturation is capped at 100%. This focused check does not establish diagnosis accuracy, live telephony or field outcomes.

02Prototype / MVP

DECISION SYSTEMS

NEXUS

Assumptions, possible futures and predictions that stay traceable.

  • Decision graph
  • Future exploration
  • Prediction ledger
FOCUSED SOURCE CHECKAn altered prediction is detected.＋

Three entries were sealed using the supplied Python ledger. The intact chain verifies; changing the first prediction raises TamperError. This in-memory check does not establish public timestamps, independent anchoring, forecast accuracy or a live deployment.

03Prototype / MVP

ENGINEERING VERIFICATION

VERITAS

Exact constraint checks with independently checkable evidence.

  • Exact arithmetic
  • Constraint checks
  • Proof checking
FOCUSED SOURCE CHECKContradictions and witnesses checked.＋

The supplied exact-rational Python solver rejects x ≥ 3 together with x ≤ 2, and its contradiction core rechecks. Bounds between 1 and 2 receive a satisfying witness. These focused examples do not rerun the full test suite or establish standards certification.

The checks cover individual components of supplied source. Each reader includes the reviewed excerpt, interactive examples and the limits of that evidence.
